name: Advisor NNA & Fee Efficiency Dashboard
description: New advisor fee efficiency view in the Books tab. Gold script produces daily advisor_fee_detail parquet (per-advisor, per-account, per-date with split-weighted fees and NNA) and a rollup advisor_fee_efficiency.json scorecard (~155 advisors). Scorecard includes firm-wide NNA~Revenue regression with per-advisor residuals. Portal displays scatter plot (NNA vs Revenue, dot=AUA, color=efficiency), ranked sortable table, and drill-down with time series + account breakdown. Global view in Books tab, derived views at advisor and client level.
